task.pr_title: fix: request name not updating in the save request modal

cases.provenance: A human reviewer flagged this defect in an inline comment on the reviewed pull request.
cases.description:
Here since the ref `requestName` is initialized when the component is rendered first. it won't be updated if there is an update to the currentActiveTab.value, for eg: try renaming the request, and see the value in the save request model.

you can add a watcher on the restRequestName that will update the ref incase the name changes from the tabs side. 

```javascript
watch(restRequestName, (newValue) => {
  requestName.value = newValue
})
```
